summary: Backend: all 31 pytest tests passed (auth, categories, products, wishlist, orders, reviews, coupons, banners, settings, admin stats). Frontend: Home renders, Admin login + Dashboard work, but /products page throws an uncaught React runtime error breaking the customer shopping experience. Admin sub-routes appear to lose admin session when navigated directly.

minor.issue: Status is passed as query param (`?status=shipped`) instead of JSON body — works but is non-standard REST.
Returns dict directly (no Pydantic response model); inconsistent with other endpoints.
Falls back to hardcoded default 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' if env var missing — should fail-fast in production.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Uncaught runtime error 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string'. Page is completely blank/broken for end users. Likely a Shadcn Select with <SelectItem value=""> used for an 'All categories' option — Radix Select forbids empty string values.
There is no /login route — Sign In is only available via a dialog inside the Navbar. Direct deep-link /login returns blank page. Consider adding /login route or documenting the dialog UX.

integration_issues.issue: Navigating directly to /admin/products (or refreshing) after admin login shows AdminLogin instead of the products page. Admin token/state likely not being read from localStorage on mount of admin sub-route guard.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Replace empty-string SelectItem value in Products.js category filter with a non-empty sentinel like 'all' (Radix Select disallows ''). This is blocking the entire customer browse flow.
Verify AdminProtectedRoute reads token+role from localStorage on mount so direct admin sub-route navigation does not bounce to /admin/login.
Consider adding a dedicated /login route (or redirect) so deep links don't yield a blank page.
Move JWT_SECRET to mandatory env var; remove hardcoded default.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines covering all domains — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, products, orders, admin) for maintainability.
update_order_status takes status as query param; should be JSON body with enum validation (pending/processing/shipped/delivered).
Settings endpoint has no Pydantic response model; inconsistent.
No pagination on list endpoints (products, orders, reviews) — to_list(1000) will not scale.
Image upload accepts any content-type via base64 with no size/type validation — risk of large payloads and XSS via SVG.

success_rate.frontend: ~50% (homepage + admin dashboard OK; products page broken; admin deep-link broken)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@eshop.com / admin123 (working). Customer: created TEST_user_*@example.com via /api/auth/register during tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_-prefixed categories, products, reviews, banners, and one coupon (TEST<rand>). One order was created and left for admin stats verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is comprehensive and currently green. Re-run after frontend fixes. Key remaining frontend flows to verify after main agent fix: products listing & filter, add-to-cart, checkout, order placement as customer, admin CRUD pages (products/categories/orders/reviews/coupons/banners/settings), dark mode toggle.
rca of the issue: Products page error: Shadcn/Radix UI Select requires SelectItem.value to be non-empty. In Products.js a SelectItem (likely for 'All Categories') uses value="". When React renders the Select, Radix throws and the error boundary takes over the page. Fix: change value="" to value="all" and treat 'all' as no-filter in the onValueChange handler.
